title: Helix Systems — stabilization & handoff prep (personal notes)
content:
Meeting: Helix Systems — stabilization / handoff 1:1 prep
Owner: Ivy Chen (notes to self)
Meeting with Helix Ops: 2026-03-12 14:00 PT (Sarah Liao, Tom Becker) — goal: sign off on stabilization checklist and schedule operations handoff

Objectives (what I want to achieve in the sync)
- Confirm remaining preflight items so SRE/Helix can run day-0 to day-7 smoke tests without Redwood on-call.
- Get explicit owners and dates for network egress, KMS access, and monitoring ingestion.
- Lock the rollback path and validate DNS/traffic switch plan.
- Agree on telemetry retention and alert thresholds for first 30 days.

Quick context summary for the customer call (one-liners to drop)
- Two weeks of on-site validation completed; avg token latency at p95 = 210ms under baseline load (50 rps).
- Autoscaler config still conservative; we recommend bump to 2x buffer after week 1 of production.
- Remaining hard blockers are networking egress and KMS policy binding.

Preflight checklist (status: ✅ done / ⚠️ partial / ⛔ blocker)
- VPC peering & routing: ✅ peering established, route table updated (Helix confirmed).
- Subnet IP capacity: ⚠️ one AZ close to threshold (AZ-b ~18% free) — owner: Marco (due 2026-03-13).
- Firewall egress: ⛔ blocked for S3 endpoints from worker subnets — blocker; Helix network ticket open (PD-1023).
- DNS entries & low TTL: ✅ hosted zone created, TTL set to 60s for switch window.
- KMS access + key policy: ⛔ Helix IAM needs Redwood role binding for decrypt; waiting on KMS admin (owner: Priya to escalate, due 2026-03-11).
- Bastion SSH key rotation: ✅ keys uploaded to Vault, access tested.
- Image registry auth: ✅ ephemeral creds via Helix ECR role tested.
- Node kernel compatibility: ✅ Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, recommended kernel patches applied.

Install & validation (smoke tests to hand off)
- Agent install flow: run infra-helm chart (PR 178) -> verify agent pods in all AZs -> validate KV cache warm.
  - Smoke pass criteria: agent x10 warm starts in <45s, KV cache hit rate >85% on repeat prompt.
  - Owner: Samir (run smoke suite, 2026-03-12).
- Inference roundtrip: sample prompts from Helix dataset (100 requests across AZs) p95 latency target <300ms.
  - Owner: Ivy (coordinate test, 2026-03-12).
- Load soak: 1 hour at 2x expected prod load, watch token throttling, queue depth.
  - Owner: Helix Ops + Redwood runbook (handoff day).

Observability & alerts (must be agreed before signoff)
- Prometheus targets: redis, agent, model runtime, ingress. Verify scrape configs.
- Grafana dashboards: add panel for token cost per-minute and per-1000-tokens (customer wants cost visibility).
- Alerts to create:
  - model-runtime-p95 > 500ms for 3m -> P1 to Helix oncall and Redwood SRE (contact escalation path).
  - agent-crashloop > 5m -> automatic restart + page.
  - backlog-queue-length > 300 -> scale trigger.
- Retention: logs 30 days, traces 7 days (Helix asked for 90d logs in UX meeting — need business signoff).
  - Owner: Marco to confirm compliance and cost (2026-03-14).

Security & compliance notes
- KMS policy must allow Redwood-delegated decryption role with key usage logging enabled.
- TLS cert rotation: ensure cert-manager cron job scheduled; test manual rotation during maintenance window.
- Data residency: Helix requires EU-only TTL for some datasets — confirm model routing policy excludes EU-only data from US-hosted caches.

Rollback and fallback plan (must be practiced)
- Primary rollback: revert to pinned model image tag (image pin PR prepared) and flip traffic back to hosted Redwood fallback endpoint via DNS alias (TTL 60s).
- Emergency fallback: route specific routes to Redwood-hosted lower-cost endpoint (pre-authorized and token scoped).
- Manual steps doc: /confluence/PD/HELIX+Rollback+Playbook (linked).
- Smoke validation after rollback: 15m smoke run validating auth and latency.

Open blockers (explicit to raise during sync)
- Firewall egress to S3 (blocking model artifact pulls during scale) — JIRA PD-1023 — owner: Helix network (Sarah) — ask for ETA during call.
- KMS role binding — prevents final key policy sign-off — owner: Priya (I will escalate to Helix security lead if no ETA).
- Observability ingestion rate limit — Helix ELB is throttling metrics when we push high-cardinality labels; need to drop some labels or open ingestion quota ticket (JIRA PD-1041).

Proposed agenda for the 1:1 (6–8 min per topic, keep tight)
1) Quick status & signoff checklist overview (me, 3m)
2) Blockers & actionable owners (each person confirms ETA, 12m)
3) Walk through rollback path and DNS switch steps (5m)
4) Observability retention + alerting thresholds (8m)
5) Confirm dates for SRE-only run & final handoff (5m)
6) AOB / next steps (2m)

Action items (clear owners + due dates)
- Marco: confirm AZ-b IP expansion or alternative subnet plan (due 2026-03-13).
- Priya: escalate KMS role binding + provide final policy to Helix security (due 2026-03-11).
- Samir: execute agent smoke suite and post results to PR comment (due 2026-03-12).
- Ivy: run inference roundtrip test and share filtered latency metrics (due 2026-03-12).
- Helix (Sarah): update network ticket PD-1023 with S3 egress ETA and confirm port list (due 2026-03-11).
- Marco: open PD-1041 follow-up for metrics ingestion quota if Helix cannot raise limits (due 2026-03-13).

Notes to self (things I should say or avoid)
- Say: "We can do a conservative autoscaler bump two weeks post-handoff — avoids immediate cost shock."
- Avoid promising EU log retention >30 days until Marco confirms cost estimate.
- Call out: runbook includes a pre-cut checklist that Helix must complete 24h before traffic switch.

Follow-up cadence suggestion
- Daily 15m for next 3 days while blockers being closed, then bi-weekly 30m during first 2 weeks of live.

End-personal checklist before call
- open PR 178 comment with smoke results ✅
- attach short rollback steps to calendar invite ✅
- have quick link list in Slack message to Helix team (confluence, jira, pr) ✅

---
Footer: personal scratch — will convert to customer-facing checklist after sync and drop into confluence under Helix Private Deployment.
